snippet.title: Interstellar Sentinel 2.0.0 Launch Trailer - Now with 177% More AWESOME SAUCE
snippet.description:
Interstellar Sentinel is a lifelong dream to build the games I've grown up playing! A sincere thank you and shout out to our fans and Beloved Community for all the support. The game would not be what it is without you! 

Wishlist Interstellar Sentinel over on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2426610/Interstellar_Sentinel/

Join me on my passion project journey to build a shooter, shoot’em up, SHMUP called Interstellar Sentinel Using @SHMUP Creator with a ton of inspiration from a classic game genre that I have been playing my entire life, starting with Life Force on the NES.

If you made it this far, thank you for reading. If you want to become part of the development process by helping with playtesting and giving feedback, head on over to our Interstellar Sentinel Discord server https://discord.gg/rh5qhMaSzX

Connect with us on our socials!
I.S. Discord: https://discord.gg/rh5qhMaSzX

I.S. SubReddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Interstellar_Sentinel/

I.S. Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCqdl-3vujHKUDF2nsiXFnPA

I.S. Steam Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2426610
